items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: He didn't sound to me. I'm sure, I'm not positive, but I'm sure I know him.

ctx.x: He made, he cut two records down here for Aladdin in like 1954, 1953. He did Saints Go Marching In and Wine, Women and Whiskey. That's two things he did down here.

He didn't sound to me. I'm sure, I'm not positive, but I'm sure I know him. Like I said, man, you can get so clattered up by mixing and doing so many different things. You know exactly what one person does and what the other one don't do. Like I got confused with him. He really looked for me.
About stuff like stuff I haven't met him.
